summary: Iteration 30 — Veo URL pre-check on POST /api/me/url-fetch. Verified both backend (3/3 pytest) and frontend (UI toast + help copy + regression tab). All assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: url_video_fetch.py: regex pre-check is precise (case-insensitive, anchored at scheme+host) and runs before any yt-dlp work — pre-check is O(1) and well under the 5s SLA confirmed in the timing assertion.
_friendly_error() also has a Veo branch for 'too large/filesize' (lines 101-102) — kept as a safety net even though the pre-check fires first; good defensive layering.
UploadPage.jsx help copy uses JSX entities & / ' / “/” — verified rendered DOM text is correct (no literal '&' visible).
Toast duration ramp (5s → 12s for msg.length > 80) works — the 218-char Veo message stays on-screen long enough to read.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded testfree-mar account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Veo pre-check verified end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/me/url-fetch with a Veo /clubs/.../clips/... or /matches/... URL returns HTTP 400 with detail starting with 'Veo links can't be fetched directly — full matches are several GB. On Veo, open the clip → ⋯ → Download to save the MP4 to your device, then use the \'Upload File\' tab here. Max 5 min / 200 MB.' Direct MP4 regression (w3schools mov_bbb.mp4 ≈1MB) still returns 200 + token + preview_url + size_mb. Frontend: toast surfaces the full friendly message at 12s duration; help copy under URL input renders 'Veo & YouTube links can't be fetched directly — download the clip to your device, then use Upload File above.' with no escape artefacts. Upload File tab regression OK (dropzone visible after switching back).
rca of the issue: Not a bug fix testing iteration — verified the product-side fix in url_video_fetch.py (lines 50-71, 210-218) and UploadPage.jsx (lines 234-244, 638-667). Original symptom (Danish user report): pasting a Veo /clubs/<club>/clips/<uuid>/ URL surfaced yt-dlp's raw 'ERROR: Unsupported URL' because that route is not in yt-dlp's Veo extractor (only /matches/<slug>/). The fix detects both Veo URL variants with _VEO_CLIP_RX / _VEO_MATCH_RX and raises HTTPException(400, _veo_help_message()) before calling yt-dlp, so users see an actionable instruction (download from Veo → Upload File) instead of a stack trace. Both Veo URL shapes confirmed rejected in <10s (no 2-min hang). Direct MP4 path unaffected.
